owner_creation.analysis: The cmd_col c_int owns the displayed cursor column; reset/clear initialize it and character output advances it by measured display width.
owner_creation.invariant: Cursor columns describe display state rather than byte storage.

aliases_escapes.analysis: Width helpers and motion paths read/copy the cmd_col scalar while cp points into command bytes; the number does not own that cursor or the prompt string.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A display column cannot validate a byte pointer.

callback_targets.analysis: putchr/putstr/putbs output accompanies cmd_col width updates, but no callback context is stored in the column integer.
callback_targets.invariant: Rendering calls do not transfer column ownership.

invalidation.analysis: Repaint/scroll/prompt replacement can invalidate cmd_col-to-cp correspondence even while cmdbuf remains at a static address.
invalidation.invariant: Display metadata must be refreshed after layout changes.

mutation_commit.analysis: Motion updates cp and cmd_col separately and uses signed arithmetic around sc_width/prompt_col; no transaction rolls all values back after rendering errors.
mutation_commit.invariant: Cursor and column updates lack a joint typed commit.

release_pair.analysis: The cmd_col scalar needs no free; consuming backspace output changes the logical column, not the allocation or lifetime of command text.
release_pair.invariant: Column movement does not retire the command owner.

error_cleanup.analysis: Output failure and invalid geometry cannot be represented by the cmd_col count alone; checks in cmd_right/left rely on valid surrounding editor state.
error_cleanup.invariant: A plausible column is not a successful-output receipt.

signals_handoff.analysis: cmd_home uses cmd_col relative to prompt_col to step cp left; a reentrant mismatch could violate the cursor boundary assumption, the entry-specific M0-MEM-001 concern.
signals_handoff.invariant: Column state is reviewed with its coupled raw cursor.
limitations: Source-specific review of coupled legacy editor state; M0-MEM-001 remains open and no new runtime defect is asserted from raw-pointer structure alone.
The specific condition is cmd_col/prompt_col disagreeing with cp when cmd_home calls cmd_step_left; this is not an observed new under-read.
